summary: tag publication could bypass the repository's full exact-SHA qualification
evidence: publish.yml accepted any version-matching v* tag after build, tests, and package smoke; it did not require the tagged commit to be on main or prove that the broader CI gates passed for that exact SHA

summary: the defect-recorder contract overclaimed clean deletion detection
evidence: in a two-row temporary ledger, rewriting the session file to contain only the second valid row plus a canonical newline made readDefects return one row; deleting the whole session file returned zero, while README and the invariant claimed damaged evidence could not become a smaller history

summary: the first static oracle index could manufacture absence for valid Vitest names
evidence: adversarial fixtures produced incomplete=[] and absent for namespace fixture DSLs, imported/class runtime registrars, includeSource tests, gitignored conventional tests, and unicode or hex escaped literal titles even though Vitest can register those names

summary: defect recording could redirect committed evidence through symlinks
evidence: A temporary consumer replaced .coherence/defects with an outside-directory symlink and recordDefect created its ledger outside the repository; replacing the canonical session file with an outside-file symlink appended through that target.

summary: a re-addressed defect row could carry terminal control bytes in repository provenance
evidence: A valid row's repo.commit was replaced with deadbeef followed by an ESC clear-screen sequence and its content id recomputed; readDefects accepted it and the human renderer emitted the live escape byte.

summary: the static oracle floor could false-red tests registered by module loading
evidence: Isolated conventional test fixtures whose only declarations came from a bare side-effect import, top-level dynamic import, or top-level require each produced fullNames=[], incomplete=[], and an absent resolution.

summary: the defect-recorder contract overstated authentication and tamper guarantees
evidence: Release audit showed a valid row can be rewritten with a recomputed unkeyed id, direct callers can forge session/agent/job labels, repo fields may be null, and the stable symlink checks are not an openat-grade defense against privileged parent-directory rename races; authored docs called these immutable, exact identity, and unconditional containment.

summary: the static oracle floor false-reds a valid locally re-aliased Vitest declaration
evidence: A conventional fixture with import { test as base } from 'vitest'; const check = base; check('live oracle', () => {}) produced fullNames=[], incomplete=[], and resolveStaticOracle(..., 'live oracle')=absent.

summary: the static oracle floor omitted live Vitest tests under broadly excluded directories
evidence: With ordinary.test.ts plus build/live.test.ts declaring 'build live', the index returned only ordinary, incomplete=[], and absent for 'build live'. Vitest v4 defaults exclude only node_modules and .git, while filesystemTestPaths skipped NOISE_DIRS and every dot directory.

summary: the static oracle scanner followed test-file symlinks outside the project root
evidence: filesystemTestPaths admitted a conventional file symlink and indexStaticVitestOracles read it with readFile, so zero-execution verification could consume outside-root source; directory symlinks were instead silently skipped and could manufacture absence.

summary: concurrent release recovery moved v0.36.0 after its first publish failure
evidence: The remote tag changed from annotated object 78b194df (peeled 269b216) to lightweight fdbb597 before fdbb597's exact main CI completed; Publish run 32395624524 was correctly refused by the CI guard, npm remained E404, and the compromised tag was deleted rather than published.

summary: publish qualification rejected a valid annotated tag because checkout replaced its local ref with the peeled commit
evidence: GitHub run 32398246365 fetched annotated object 8c455f77, then force-fetched commit 5afa03c into refs/tags/v0.36.1; cat-file saw commit and the guard exited before setup or npm publication

summary: an unrelated dynamic Vitest title masks every statically vanished oracle claim
evidence: Mnemion on coherence 0.36.2 renamed the clipboard oracle; verify --fast returned static oracle existence UNKNOWN because 15 unrelated template-generated chart titles populated one project-wide incomplete list. Current resolveStaticOracle checks index.incomplete globally after zero literal matches.

summary: Cloudflare infra graph derivation depends on an uncommitted wrangler deployment toggle
evidence: Mnemion clean-clone simulation regenerated a graph differing by i:DOCUMENTS plus three binds edges. buildGraph asks platform.bindings(root), and the Cloudflare adapter reads only the current wrangler.jsonc/toml, so committed code using the binding cannot stabilize the graph while the deployment toggle remains local.

summary: the per-claim batch-attribution test is timing-sensitive because it rejects a passing claim name even in the independent holding-cost advisory
evidence: full suite on v0.36.3 candidate: 837/838 passed; test/test-batch.test.ts:314 failed when the passing outer/inner claim took 418ms and was legitimately rendered under holding cost, despite remaining absent from red claim verdict lines

summary: Cloudflare bindings.vars embeds working-tree deployment values in graph.json, so identical committed source still produces machine-specific artifacts
evidence: 0.36.3 adopter report from Mnemion: clean checkout and deploy checkout now derive identical infra nodes/edges, but WORKER_HOST differs between committed placeholder and deploy-machine wrangler value; docs --check fails on that single serialized vars line
